crossRefs.note: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many…
and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief…
They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…

translations.web: He put them all together into custody for three days.
translations.bsb: So Joseph imprisoned them for three days,
translations.kjv: And he put them all together into ward three days.
translations.asv: And he put them all together into ward three days.
